tasks.label: 1. Flash MicroPython firmware (one time)
tasks.command: esptool --chip esp32c3 erase-flash; esptool --chip esp32c3 --baud 460800 write-flash 0 '${input:firmware}'

tasks.label: 3. Upload main.py + secrets.py (runs on every boot)
tasks.command: mpremote cp main.py :main.py + cp secrets.py :secrets.py + reset

tasks.label: 5. Restart board (instead of the reset button)

inputs.description: Path to the ESP32_GENERIC_C3 .bin from micropython.org/download/ESP32_GENERIC_C3
